declared_opinions: node identity is arn-if-present ELSE id (:33-34), so AWS nodes key on ARN and portal nodes key on their path/name -- ONE column holding TWO id spaces by design
on a key collision the FIRST node seen wins and later ones are discarded silently (:53-54); classes_data iteration order therefore decides which duplicate survives

an edge with an unresolved endpoint is dropped, and the drop is EXCUSED as 'wildcard/external' when _wild() matches -- a classifier that treats any id containing '*' or '::' or ':ecs:' as expected-missing (:140-145)
MERGE rather than CREATE means a re-run UPDATES in place and NEVER DELETES: nodes removed from the input persist in the DB until someone passes --force
the only quality gate is UNTYPED_NODES == 0 (:105-108, rc at :129); nothing checks counts, layers or edge resolution against any expectation
IF NOT EXISTS on both DDL statements accepts a pre-existing table with different columns -- live risk, since two sibling loaders declare these same names differently

failure_mode.evidence: EXERCISED 2026-08-27T06:3xZ against scratch DBs under --db; repo artifacts never touched. (a) MISSING INPUT IS LOUD: --in pointing at a non-existent file raises an UNCAUGHT FileNotFoundError from :46 with a traceback and rc=1. (b) THE TYPED-NESS GATE IS REAL: :105-108 counts nodes with empty/NULL node_type and :129 returns rc=1 when that count is non-zero -- an actual quality gate on the exit code, which the sibling subject has no equivalent of. (c) ⛔ THE DANGEROUS ONE -- MERGE MEANS DELETIONS NEVER PROPAGATE, AND THE MANIFEST LIES ABOUT IT. Exercised: built a scratch DB from a 5-node input (manifest node_count=5), then re-ran against a SHRUNKEN 2-node input with no --force. The run printed 'INFO: NODES loaded = 2', 'OK: UNTYPED_NODES count=0', 'OK: KUZU_STITCH_LOAD_COMPLETE' and exited rc=0. ORACLE: the DB then held 5 NODES while the manifest claimed node_count=2. THE PROVENANCE STAMP REPORTS THE INPUT'S SIZE, NOT THE STORE'S -- :123 passes len(best), which is the deduped INPUT count, into write_manifest. Under MERGE semantics those two quantities are not the same number, and the manifest is the artifact whose entire purpose is making the store's vintage and scale checkable. _provenance.py:6-8 says comp-kuzu prints this manifest as a provenance header on EVERY invocation, so a consumer reading that header can be told a node count that is wrong about the DB in front of it. ⛔ NOT TRUE OF THE SIBLING: kuzu_load writes its manifest only inside the rebuild branch, where the DB was just dropped and repopulated from exactly those nodes, so its count is accurate at write time. The defect is created by MERGE, not by _provenance.

key.evidence: identity_space measured at :70-71 -- `node_id STRING PRIMARY KEY` -- and populated at :33-34 by _key(), which is arn-if-present ELSE id. THIS IS A DELIBERATELY MIXED IDENTITY SPACE: AWS nodes key on ARN, portal nodes key on their path/name, and BOTH live in the `node_id` column with the ARN also duplicated into a separate `arn` column when present. The docstring at :8-10 states the intent -- the two layers join on shared ARN-keyed nodes. key_is_stable=unstable IS THE MEASURED VALUE AND IT IS NOT THE ARN'S FAULT: the portal half of the space keys on a path/name, so a file rename or move mints a NEW node_id and the predecessor is unlinked with no forwarding. verdict.why: EVERY ROW MEASURED, so this is not INCOMPLETE. UNSOUND is scoped to STANDING AS LOAD-BEARING SUBSTRATE and is not a claim the script is broken: exercised with --force and a current input it loads correctly and its typed-ness gate genuinely fires. Four measured facts block standing on it. (1) A NIGHTLY IS DECLARED (critical-surfaces.yaml:163) AND THE ARTIFACT IS 50.60 DAYS OLD -- DESIRED is not APPLIED, measured from a stamp the writer emits unconditionally. (2) THE INPUT HAS MOVED 18 DAYS PAST THE ARTIFACT DERIVED FROM IT and nothing re-ran the load, so the served DB is a projection of a superseded revision of its own source. (3) THE BUILD MANIFEST CAN BE WRONG ABOUT THE STORE -- exercised at 2 claimed vs 5 held -- and comp-kuzu prints that manifest as its provenance header, so the instrument built to make staleness checkable is itself unsound for this subject under its own MERGE semantics. (4) SUPERSEDED: kuzu_nessie_db carries every layer this DB has, plus ms and semctl, at 27,035 nodes and 0.67d.
